cards.ex: He always wears a bespoke suit to important business meetings.
cards.exUz: U muhim biznes uchrashuvlariga doim buyurtma kostyum kiyadi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy o'lchovlar bo'yicha maxsus tikilgan kostyum.

cards.ex: She was dressed to impress at the party, hoping to meet potential clients.
cards.exUz: U partida potentsial mijozlar bilan uchrashishga umid qilib, ta'sir qilish uchun kiyingan edi.
cards.uzDef: Birovlarga yoqish uchun chiroyli va zamonaviy kiyingan.

cards.ex: She's incredibly fashion-savvy and always knows what's trending.
cards.exUz: U juda moda bilimdoni va har doim nima urfda ekanligini biladi.
cards.uzDef: Modani yaxshi tushunadigan va biladigan.

cards.ex: I usually shop around before buying clothes to get the best deals.
cards.exUz: Men odatda eng yaxshi narxni olish uchun kiyim sotib olishdan oldin narx so'rayman.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi narxni topish uchun turli do'konlarni qidirish.

cards.ex: The retail outlet had a huge sale on winter coats.
cards.exUz: Chakana savdo nuqtasida qishki paltolarga katta chegirma bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Kiyim-kechak sotadigan do'kon yoki savdo markazi.

cards.ex: Her style is very a la mode, always keeping up with the latest trends.
cards.exUz: Uning uslubi juda moda bo'yicha, har doim so'nggi trendlardan xabardor.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi moda trendlariga mos keladigan.

cards.ex: Dress code compliance is strictly enforced in this office.
cards.exUz: Ushbu ofisda kiyim qoidalariga rioya qilish qat'iy nazorat qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Muassasaning kiyim qoidalariga rioya qilish.

cards.ex: When I'm working from home, I always dress for comfort.
cards.exUz: Uyda ishlaganimda, men har doim qulay kiyim kiyaman.
cards.uzDef: Qulay bo'lish uchun kiyinish.

cards.ex: The environmental impact of fast fashion is a growing concern.
cards.exUz: Tezkor modaning atrof-muhitga ta'siri ortib borayotgan muammo.
cards.uzDef: Tez ishlab chiqariladigan va arzon kiyimlar.

cards.ex: She only buys high-end fashion from well-known designers.
cards.exUz: U faqat taniqli dizaynerlardan yuqori moda kiyimlarini sotib oladi.
cards.uzDef: Qimmatbaho materiallardan tayyorlangan eksklyuziv kiyimlar.

cards.ex: If you want to be taken seriously, you need to dress the part.
cards.exUz: Agar sizga jiddiy munosabatda bo'lishlarini istasangiz, rolga mos kiyinishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan rol yoki vaziyatga mos kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: The tailor made sure the dress was a perfect fit.
cards.exUz: Tikuvchi ko'ylakning mukammal o'lchamda bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kiyimning ideal o'lchamda ekanligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: We have dress down Friday at work, so I usually wear jeans.
cards.exUz: Bizda ishda erkin kiyinish juma kuni bor, shuning uchun men odatda jinsi kiyaman.
cards.uzDef: Juma kunlari ofisda oddiy kiyim kiyishga ruxsat berilgan kun.

cards.ex: Her style is all about timeless elegance, she always looks classy.
cards.exUz: Uning uslubi abadiy nafislik haqida, u har doim oqlangan ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qachon modadan qolmaydigan nafis uslub.

cards.ex: They were dressed to the teeth for the opera.
cards.exUz: Ular opera uchun eng yaxshi kiyimlarni kiyishgan.
cards.uzDef: Juda zamonaviy va hashamatli kiyingan.

cards.ex: She manages to look stylish even on a shoestring budget.
cards.exUz: U juda kam byudjet bilan ham zamonaviy ko'rinishga erishadi.
cards.uzDef: Kiyim-kechak uchun juda kam pul sarflash.

cards.ex: Her bright pink coat was definitely a fashion statement.
cards.exUz: Uning yorqin pushti paltosi, albatta, moda bayonoti edi.
cards.uzDef: O'z uslubini namoyish etadigan o'ziga xos kiyim.

cards.ex: Platform shoes are the latest craze among teenagers.
cards.exUz: Platforma poyabzallar o'smirlar orasida so'nggi urf.
cards.uzDef: Ayni paytda juda mashhur bo'lgan narsa (moda, kiyim va hokazo).

cards.ex: She dreams of becoming a runway model one day.
cards.exUz: U bir kun kelib defile modeli bo'lishni orzu qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Moda namoyishlarida kiyim namoyish qiladigan model.

cards.ex: You should dress up smartly for the job interview.
cards.exUz: Ish intervyusi uchun chiroyli kiyinishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nafis va zamonaviy kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: She wore a stylish ensemble consisting of a skirt and blouse.
cards.exUz: U yubka va bluzadan iborat zamonaviy ansambl kiygan edi.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda yaxshi ko'rinadigan kiyimlar to'plami.

cards.ex: It's hard to keep up with trends because they change so quickly.
cards.exUz: Trendlardan qolmaslik qiyin, chunki ular juda tez o'zgaradi.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi moda trendlaridan xabardor bo'lish.

cards.ex: Well-cut clothes can make you look more professional.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi bichilgan kiyimlar sizni yanada professional ko'rsatishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi bichilgan va shaklga mos keladigan kiyim.

cards.ex: I bought a winter coat at an off-season sale for a great price.
cards.exUz: Men qishki paltoni mavsumdan tashqari chegirmada ajoyib narxga sotib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Mavsum tugagandan keyin kiyim-kechakka beriladigan chegirma.

cards.ex: She always dresses with flair, making her outfits unique.
cards.exUz: U har doim did bilan kiyinadi va kiyimlarini noyob qiladi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga xos uslubda va did bilan kiyinish.

cards.ex: She wore statement jewelry to add some sparkle to her outfit.
cards.exUz: U kiyimiga biroz yorqinlik qo'shish uchun ajoyib zargarlik buyumlarini taqdi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni tortadigan katta va zamonaviy zargarlik buyumlari.

cards.ex: Haute couture fashion shows are known for their extravagant designs.
cards.exUz: Yuqori moda namoyishlari o'zining hashamatli dizaynlari bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Maxsus buyurtma asosida tikilgan yuqori sifatli kiyimlar.

cards.ex: Many follow fashion bloggers for style inspiration.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik uslub ilhomi uchun moda blogerlarini kuzatadi.
cards.uzDef: Moda haqida blog yuritadigan shaxs.

cards.ex: The school has strict dress code enforcement.
cards.exUz: Maktabda kiyim qoidalarini bajarish qat'iy.
cards.uzDef: Kiyim qoidalariga rioya qilishni ta'minlash.

cards.ex: His decision to wear a velvet suit was definitely a sartorial choice.
cards.exUz: Uning baxmal kostyum kiyish qarori, albatta, kiyim tanlovi edi.
cards.uzDef: Kiyimni tanlash usuli, ayniqsa did bilan tanlash.
